conjecture: Group-input polar closeness: there exist universal C_grp, C_pol >= 1, kappa_pol in (0, 1/2] such that for every finite-dimensional exact-unit epsilon_r-C*-algebra and delta > 0 satisfying C_pol*(epsilon_r + delta) <= kappa_pol and C_grp*epsilon_r < delta - C_pol*(epsilon_r*delta + delta^2), the inverse u_delta:S_delta -> calU of the polar map satisfies ||u_delta(U bold-dot V) - U bold-dot V|| <= C_grp*epsilon_r and ||u_delta(U^dagger) - U^dagger|| <= C_grp*epsilon_r for every U, V in calU.
